description: Font family packs: a mandatory platform core plus an independent inclusion decision per optional pack. Servability is `none`: the browser does NOT check whether the claimed platform's faces are on disk, and a pack is drawable unconditionally. Provisioning is the user's setup step and the documentation tells them what to install; the binary assumes it is done. `requires.families` is kept as a DECLARATIVE statement of the families each pack names -- for the macOS core pack it is the 30-name subset that the 76-name probe list used by the common unattended fingerprinters actually tests, which is the part worth being able to point at -- and is no longer a precondition on anything. This does not let a pack claim faces the host lacks: patch 0090's enumeration filter is subtractive, so the visible set is always the intersection of this list with what the host really has. Assuming provisioning means the browser stops checking, not that it starts claiming absent faces.
label: font_packs

options.note: MEASURED. The complete enumerable family set of the reference Mac, not the 32 names a 76-name probe list happened to cover. Patch 0090 makes this list the font surface, and the filter is subtractive, so a list shorter than the machine's real one is itself the tell: enforcing the old 32-name pack would have presented a Mac with 30 visible families. `requires.families` stays the smaller 30-name mandatory subset -- the names the cheap unattended probe lists (FingerprintJS and friends) actually test -- because a core pack is never dropped and conflating `requires` with `value` is what produced the 32. Two names the old pack listed, Courier and Times, are NOT enumerable families on the host: they resolve for CSS and for the last-resort path but never appear in queryLocalFonts, so they are out of the enumerable list.
options.source: local/macos-m4max-queryLocalFonts-20260918.json; queryLocalFonts with a real permission grant on the macos-metal-apple-850a91233555 anchor host (Apple M4 Max, macOS 26.6.2): 184 families / 536 faces

options.note: Installed-software bundle. A pack is all-or-nothing: installed fonts arrive together, and a handful of individually drawn families is synthesis and a tell (docs/FINGERPRINTS.md section 3). Microsoft Office for Mac font set. Mandatory core set: the families the claimed platform cannot be without. Membership is the family list of a Windows 11 English release font set, redistributed at https://github.com/liblaf/fonts/releases/download/Win11/Win11-English.zip and unpacked rather than vendored here; 37 of them are additionally confirmed present by this project's own Windows capture, whose probe list is bounded and so cannot speak to the rest. Enumeration is subtractive and always servable, so a family the host lacks simply does not appear; a missing core family is the defensible failure, an absent one is not.

Microsoft Office for Windows font set, excluding the families Windows itself already ships. AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED: the family list is the bundle's published contents, and the weight is an authored prevalence. Carries no generic family: all five are set unconditionally on the platform core pack, because a generic gated on an optional pack would leave the host's own generic in effect whenever that pack is not drawn.
